conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLA: Resolved only for status: EO 13138 Sec. 3(f) expressly names EO 12852 as amended by these listed amendment orders and Sec. 9 supplies an explicit delayed effective date. This does not decide when any individual amended clause first ceased.

notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: Provisional NO recommendation as of 2026-10-14 is based on EO 13138 Sec. 3(f), which expressly lists EO 12852 as amended by EOs 12855, 12965, 12980, 13053, and 13114 and states that these listed committee-establishing orders are revoked, together with Sec. 9: “This order shall be effective September 30, 1999.” I inspected the full three-page official Federal Register PDF image and matched its identity/date/body to the held text; the delayed operative date is September 30, 1999, not the September 30 signing date by assumption. This is a status recommendation only. It does not establish the first cessation date for the provisions amended by this order. No complete search through the 2026-10-14 cutoff is available to address any later restoration/revival, so retain that limitation for review. EO 12852’s official original PDF remains unheld; therefore its exact base text and original clauses remain a material source gap.
